description.part1: This software integrates data from the
description.part2: project. This project provides comprehensive ROM Chinese-English name mappings covering most mainstream retro gaming platforms. Through fuzzy matching algorithms, we can automatically identify and match Chinese names when scraping metadata.

alerts.selectPlatformFirst: Please select a game platform first

confirms.autoFixNaming:
Are you sure you want to match English names?
This will scan all ROMs in the directory and automatically match English names based on the local database.
Only matches with very high confidence (>95%) will be applied.
Results will be saved to the temporary directory.
confirms.setAsRomName:
Are you sure you want to set extracted Chinese names as ROM names?
This will write the Chinese names extracted from filenames to temporary metadata.
confirms.addAsTag:
Are you sure you want to add English names as extra tags?
This will write matched English names as x-mrrm-eng tags to temporary metadata.
